AMENDMENT NO. 4  
TO 
BIS LABORATORY RECOGNITION SCHEME 2020 
 
(Page 3, clause 4.1.2, para 1) ― Substitute the amended para  for the existing para,  as mentioned 
below: 
Amended Para 
 
Scope for recognition – Recognition under BIS LRS shall be considered for Indian Standards for products. 
 
In case any Ministry /Government Department notifies any essential requirements or technical regulations 
or technical rules or any such documents which are covered/ proposed to be covered under the conformity 
assessment sche mes of BIS, then recognition under BIS LRS shall be considered for such essential 
requirements or technical regulations or technical rules or any such documents. 
 
NOTE – ‘Standard(s)’ or ‘Indian Standard (s)’ or ‘Indian Standard (s) /product(s)’ mentioned an ywhere in the ‘Laboratory 
Recognition Scheme 2020’ document and subsequent amendments, refers to the applicable ‘Indian Standard (s) or essential 
requirement or technical regulations or technical rules or any such documents.
